text: Jeffrey Cantos, Manager, City Planning, will provide a presentation on Employment Lands in the area south of Eastern Avenue and the impact of potential changes in the zoning of key sites in the area.

The Film, Television and Digital Media Advisory Board recommends that: 1. The Economic and Community Development Committee hear a presentation at its December 1, 2021 meeting from the Chief Planner and Executive Director, City Planning, in consultation with the Interim General Manager, Economic Development and Culture, on the Overview of Employment Lands in the Area South of Eastern Avenue. 2. The Economic and Community Development Committee acknowledge the importance of lands designated Core Employment Areas and General Employment Areas in the Official Plan to the protection of existing and development of new studio and production space across the City. 3.
